answer: Split-tally bond blocks bulk fake identities. Each newcomer splits one claim in two and files the first half at a haven registry. The second half is sealed under an ivory tally token, hidden from one auditor. A bridge ledger joins the halves only when two auditors tally them equal; a mismatch or reused half burns the bond. First 42, k-th 42+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,539,500 plus 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 42 once.
